correctness.rationale: Every proper ideal lies in m=U⊕W, dim(U,W)=(2,3), with W=m² and U·W=0. For S=projection to U and T=I∩W, ideal closure imposes US⊂T; each linear lift S→W/T yields a unique ideal, exhausting S=0,1,2. S=0 yields all W subspaces; S=1 forces T through a point/plane containing S·U; S=2 forces T=W. Acting automorphisms induce GL2 on U and Sym² GL2 on W; the graph-map transvections erase lift parameters. Odd-field conic tangent/secant/external orbits and even Frobenius square-plane/trace orbits then give 12 orbits, 3q²+4q+7 ideals and covers as claimed. Independently enumerated all 374 F2^5 subspaces and 26 proper stable ideals (27 total); independent full GL2(F3) Sym² projective point orbit sizes 4,6,3 and dual plane classes size 4,6,3 with incidences (1,3,0),(2,1,1),(0,2,2). q=2 computation and q=3 check support the symbolic proof; finite enumeration not substituted for universal q.
residual_risks: Symbolic case distinction for finite fields relies on standard quadratic geometry; independent code checked only q=2,3 while source certificate states further q≤9.
